title: Name and fix the Store start-up step where the Windows nervous child stalls
goal: Runtime tests stop failing with "nervous process not ready" on Windows CI
acceptance: The stalled step is named from a Windows failure whose error quotes the start-up watch ("still in start-up step …"); two openers serialising the schema is ruled out (the nervous child is the file's only opener)
A committed test fails first, then the fix; the ready deadline is raised only if measurements show a start slower than 30 s is the cause, and still fails a dead child
No "nervous process not ready" in the next five Windows runs
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: A committed regression fails before the fix
CI windows job on five runs
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25 from B-126-T01 (1.5 h). Start-up watch in #757; cause named and fixed 2026-11-25 (flushes per start-up statement on a loaded Windows disk). Remaining: five Windows runs. Not a measurement. Closed 2026-11-26.
